paragraphs: StudyStash sells an adaptive learning layer that runs alongside a college's existing LMS. The platform converts course materials into study tools such as flashcards and practice tests, supported by an AI study tutor called StudyChat. StudyStash AI is described as grounded in the instructors' original materials and aligned with course objectives. StudyChat answers student queries, marks formative assessments and returns feedback, while instructors receive reports showing where students are struggling.

The pages address colleges, instructors and students, and describe universities as the institutions implementing the platform. A year-long pilot at the University of Birmingham was set up to involve over 5,000 students in taught modules across subjects including Computer Science, Medicine and Law. Case study pages name Loughborough University, Pikes Peak State College and Eastern Washington University among the institutions working with StudyStash. Entry is offered as a pilot program of 2-3 courses before scaling.

quote.text: Think of us as the missing link between what colleges deliver and what students achieve.
